report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors. The only deployment record is baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so no faulty rollout is observed. Logs show all /v1/orders requests returning 200 with successful postgres, inventory, and payment operations. Metrics show /v1/orders 200 at ~21.3/60s and 502 at 0, with p95 ~210ms. No error evidence substantiates a deployment-caused fault; hand off for further scoping.
missing_evidence: Error-level logs or traces showing checkout failures (e.g., 5xx on /v1/orders) to confirm the alert's premise
Deployment history showing a non-baseline rollout or version change correlated with the incident window
Metrics for downstream services (inventory, payment) to rule out downstream-latency or db-pool-exhaustion causes
Gateway logs (excluded evidence) to check for errors upstream of the order service
